summary_en: Kaga Electronics completed tender offer for Shinko Shoji ordinary shares, acquiring 20,938,007 shares (70.6% of 29.6M shares outstanding ex-treasury). Tender price not disclosed in excerpt. Offer period May 18 – August 3, 2026. Minimum threshold 15,988,500 shares was met. Kaga Electronics voting stake to exceed 50% on August 10, 2026 (settlement date), making it parent company and principal shareholder of Shinko Shoji.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Tender Offer for Shinko Shoji Shares by Kaga Electronics and Change of Parent Company and Principal Shareholder
translation_en_brief: Kaga Electronics Co., Ltd. (以下「公開買付者」) completed a public tender offer for all ordinary shares of Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. (the filer) that ran from May 18 to August 3, 2026. The offer was successful: 20,938,007 shares were tendered, exceeding the minimum threshold of 15,988,500 shares. Settlement is scheduled to begin on August 10, 2026. Upon completion of settlement, Kaga Electronics' voting stake will exceed 50% of total shareholder voting rights (on a pro-forma basis, calculated against 29,612,599 shares outstanding excluding treasury), making Kaga Electronics the new parent company and principal shareholder of Shinko Shoji. The tender price per share is not disclosed in the excerpted text (see attached materials for complete terms). Kaga Electronics already held 515,000 shares (1.74% of the ex-treasury base) prior to the offer. The two companies have an existing business relationship involving mutual purchase and sale of semiconductors and electronic components.
